changelog:
* **fix: repair merge-broken imports and swatch receiver** (22a17ab)
  - Change theme swatch composable to BoxScope extension so Modifier.align resolves.
  - Point rememberSaveable import to androidx.compose.runtime.saveable package.
  - Import ColorScheme from material3 for the theme preview row.
* **fix: smooth summary progress and drop trailing period** (038f428)
  - Animate the Summary progress bar in the Currency settings with a
    400ms tween instead of jumping instantly on toggle.
  - Remove the trailing period from the English 'always stay on the
    homepage' sentence (Bangla full stop kept).
* **feat: redesign language picker with preview and apply** (3ec3c95)
  - Add select-then-apply flow for language: pending selection, shared
    pinned Apply button (with theme section), disabled until changed.
  - Replace radio rows with selectable option cards: title + description,
    primary border + checkmark when selected.
  - Sample card now previews the pending language only, with a
    current-language footer showing the applied language.
  - Generalize the discard dialog to cover theme and language sections.
  - Show an EN/Bangla badge on the Language row in Settings.
* **feat: redesign app theme picker with preview and apply** (2730f4a)
  - Add select-then-apply flow in the theme detail page: pending theme
    state, real palette preview, pinned Apply button at the bottom.
  - Preview resolves colors via cashFigureColorScheme helper shared with
    CashFigureTheme (dynamic Material You on Android 12+, static
    teal/amber otherwise), so it always matches the real result.
  - Replace radio rows with selectable option cards: title + description,
    primary border + checkmark when selected.
  - Show a confirm-discard dialog when leaving with an unapplied selection.
  - Show an applied-theme swatch on the App Theme row in Settings.
* **fix: readable countdown on disabled confirm buttons** (5d8054b)
  - Override disabled button colors in Reset and Restore dialogs.
  - Show countdown text at full opacity on a tinted error container.
* **refactor: simplify About screen** (f3e9501)
  - Remove the app description and tagline paragraphs.
  - Name "Cash Figure" in the Play Protect warning instead of "this app".
